quotes.speaker: Tyler Herro
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Herro on translating practice intensity to game situations
quotes.excerpt: we have to find a way to translate what we're doing in practice to the games
quotes.quote: I think just translating it from practice to the games is what he means. In practice, we are obviously going against each other and we're competing hard and we're trying to make each other better, iron sharpening iron. At the end of the day, it is preseason, but we have to find a way to translate what we're doing in practice to the games. Having a little bit more urgency, a little bit more care factor, that's what we've been talking about, just knowing it's preseason but knowing that the real thing starts in the next few days.
quotes.social_post: Tyler Herro says the Bucks need to bring more urgency and care factor into their preseason games to better translate their practice intensity to the court.

quotes.speaker: Tyler Herro
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Herro on the challenges of a new team and system
quotes.excerpt: we're a brand new group, new coaching staff, new system, a lot of young guys
quotes.quote: There's a lot of components here. We're a brand new group, new coaching staff, new system, a lot of young guys. Being able to take all that into consideration, it's not something that's just going to happen overnight. We're going to continue to get better. I said at one time I was speaking, I said we'll be a completely different team as the months go on and as we get towards the end of the season, but we have to continue to just work at it every single day and try to translate it to the games.
quotes.social_post: Tyler Herro on the adjustment period for the new look Bucks roster: We will be a completely different team as the months go on and as we get towards the end of the season.

quotes.speaker: Tyler Herro
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Herro on handling defensive attention and gravity
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to have a gravity to my game that is going to open up other things
quotes.quote: I get a lot of attention throughout the past few years. Guys pick me up early, whether it's full court or right when I cross half court, guys are picking me up. I've been seeing the best defender on the other team for three or four years now. I'm going to have a gravity to my game that is going to open up other things for other guys. I think just being able to counteract that, my best years I've had were on the ball, but I can do a little bit of both.
quotes.social_post: Tyler Herro discusses his role and gravity on the floor: I have been seeing the best defender on the other team for three or four years now and I can do a little bit of both on and off the ball.

quotes.speaker: Tyler Herro
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Herro on the coaching style of his new head coach
quotes.excerpt: he's urgent, he's a guy that wants things done and he wants them done the right way
quotes.quote: He's urgent. He's a guy that wants things done and he wants them done the right way. I kind of got the sense of that, how he had his Memphis teams playing, picking up full court, putting pressure on teams, playing fast. He's a tough-nosed guy. He's really urgent, like I said, and he wants things done the right way. That's the beauty of being here with a bunch of young guys that he's continuing to push us, no matter what, he expects us to continue to get better every day.
quotes.social_post: Tyler Herro describes his new head coach as urgent and tough nosed, noting that he wants things done the right way and expects the young roster to improve every single day.

quotes.speaker: Tyler Herro
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Herro on the chemistry of his new team
quotes.excerpt: you can really tell when a group is connected and that group over there is really connected
quotes.quote: It's been amazing. I was living in Miami last year, I came up for Game 2 of the NLCS. I was there last year, we ended up getting swept, but just to see how the team has come back, you can really tell when a group is connected and that group over there is really connected. You can tell they're playing for each other, they really want this for each other, but it's great to see how they're representing the city.
quotes.social_post: Tyler Herro shares his observations on team chemistry, noting that you can really tell when a group is connected and playing for each other.
